headline: The story of The Sims
title: The Sims 2000 Facts | Will Wright's Biggest Hit | Classic Games
video_script: The Sims came out in two thousand, made by Maxis and Will Wright, the creator of SimCity. There is no way to win. You just create people, build their homes and run their lives. By two thousand two it beat Myst to become the best-selling PC game at the time, and with its expansions it passed forty one million copies by two thousand four. Did you ever trap a Sim in a pool? Comment below!
description: The Sims (2000, Maxis/EA, designed by Will Wright). Passed Myst as the best-selling PC game in 2002; game + expansions passed 41 million units by September 2004.
